description: Evaluation harness board for the map-writes-the-test rig: one task list answered bare, with the code map, and with the map plus rules, across every stored run.

options.content: One invocation, one task list, three contexts: the question alone, the question with the code map, and the question with the map plus the cited rule text.

panels.title: Takeaway
panels.description: One sentence computed from the selected run's tier counts.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS ( SELECT context, tasks_total, tasks_passed, passed_tier1, passed_tier2 FROM runs r WHERE r.run_id::text = '${run}' ), tier_n AS ( SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT task_id)::int AS n FROM task_results t WHERE t.run_id::text = '${run}' GROUP BY tier ), b AS (SELECT * FROM latest WHERE context = 'bare'), m AS (SELECT * FROM latest WHERE context = 'map'), r2 AS (SELECT * FROM latest WHERE context = 'map_rules') SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b) = 0 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m) = 0 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r2) = 0 THEN 'This run is missing one of the three arms.' WHEN (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM m) > (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM b) AND (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM r2) = (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM m) AND (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM m) = (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM b) AND (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM r2) = (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM b) THEN format('Map context lifts tier 1 from %s of %s to %s of %s and does not lift tier 2.', (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM b), COALESCE((SELECT n FROM tier_n WHERE tier = 1), 0), (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM m), COALESCE((SELECT n FROM tier_n WHERE tier = 1), 0)) WHEN (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m) > (SELECT tasks_passed FROM b) AND (SELECT tasks_passed FROM r2) > (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m) THEN format('Passes rise from %s to %s to %s of %s across baseline, map only, and map + rules.', (SELECT tasks_passed FROM b), (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m), (SELECT tasks_passed FROM r2), (SELECT tasks_total FROM b)) WHEN (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m) = (SELECT tasks_passed FROM r2) AND (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m) > (SELECT tasks_passed FROM b) THEN format('Map only and Map + rules tie at %s of %s. Baseline passed %s of %s.', (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m), (SELECT tasks_total FROM m), (SELECT tasks_passed FROM b), (SELECT tasks_total FROM b)) ELSE format('Baseline %s of %s, Map only %s of %s, Map + rules %s of %s. Tier 1 is %s, %s, and %s of %s. Tier 2 is %s, %s, and %s of %s.', (SELECT tasks_passed FROM b), (SELECT tasks_total FROM b), (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m), (SELECT tasks_total FROM m), (SELECT tasks_passed FROM r2), (SELECT tasks_total FROM r2), (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM b), (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM m), (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM r2), COALESCE((SELECT n FROM tier_n WHERE tier = 1), 0), (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM b), (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM m), (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM r2), COALESCE((SELECT n FROM tier_n WHERE tier = 2), 0)) END AS takeaway

panels.title: Leading arm
panels.description: Best appears only when one arm passed more tasks than the other two.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS ( SELECT context, tasks_passed, tasks_total FROM runs r WHERE r.run_id::text = '${run}' ), best AS (SELECT MAX(tasks_passed) AS top FROM latest), leaders AS (SELECT latest.context, latest.tasks_passed FROM latest, best WHERE latest.tasks_passed = best.top) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leaders) = 1 THEN 'Best · ' || CASE leaders.context WHEN 'bare' THEN 'Baseline (no map)' WHEN 'map' THEN 'Map only' WHEN 'map_rules' THEN 'Map + rules' ELSE leaders.context END ELSE 'Tie' END || ', ' || leaders.tasks_passed || ' of ' || (SELECT tasks_total FROM latest LIMIT 1) || ' passed' AS summary FROM leaders

panels.title: Pass rate by arm
panels.description: Share of the 8 tasks passed. Eight tasks is a small sample; read deltas as signal, not proof. Runs marked seeded in the run context row were produced by the rig seeder, not a model.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'bare' THEN ROUND(100.0 * r.tasks_passed / NULLIF(r.tasks_total, 0), 1)::numeric END) AS "Baseline (no map)", MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'map' THEN ROUND(100.0 * r.tasks_passed / NULLIF(r.tasks_total, 0), 1)::numeric END) AS "Map only", MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'map_rules' THEN ROUND(100.0 * r.tasks_passed / NULLIF(r.tasks_total, 0), 1)::numeric END) AS "Map + rules" FROM runs r WHERE r.run_id::text = '${run}'

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: Total tool calls per arm for the selected run. Fewer is better: the map should replace repo crawling, not add to it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'bare' THEN r.tool_calls::int END) AS "Baseline (no map)", MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'map' THEN r.tool_calls::int END) AS "Map only", MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'map_rules' THEN r.tool_calls::int END) AS "Map + rules" FROM runs r WHERE r.run_id::text = '${run}'

panels.title: Cost per arm
panels.description: Accounted cost per arm: agent tokens, judge tokens, and tool calls at the configured rates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'bare' THEN ROUND(r.cost_usd::numeric, 4) END) AS "Baseline (no map)", MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'map' THEN ROUND(r.cost_usd::numeric, 4) END) AS "Map only", MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'map_rules' THEN ROUND(r.cost_usd::numeric, 4) END) AS "Map + rules" FROM runs r WHERE r.run_id::text = '${run}'

panels.title: Run context
panels.description: What produced the selected run. origin=seeded rows come from the rig seeder with stand-in agents and judges.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(r.label, '—') AS "Label", COALESCE(r.model, '—') AS "Model", COALESCE(r.corpus, '—') AS "Corpus", COALESCE(r.graph, '—') AS "Graph", COALESCE(r.task_list_sha, '—') AS "Task list", COALESCE(r.origin, 'real') AS "Origin", to_char(min(r.created_at), 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Started" FROM runs r WHERE r.run_id::text = '${run}' GROUP BY r.run_id, r.label, r.model, r.corpus, r.graph, r.task_list_sha, r.origin

options.content: Every stored run, including the latest. Lines are per arm; the map arms should hold or raise pass rate while cutting tool calls and cost.

panels.title: Pass rate across runs
panels.description: One point per arm per run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.created_at AS time, CASE r.context WHEN 'bare' THEN 'Baseline (no map)' WHEN 'map' THEN 'Map only' WHEN 'map_rules' THEN 'Map + rules' ELSE r.context END AS metric, ROUND(100.0 * r.tasks_passed / NULLIF(r.tasks_total, 0), 1)::numeric AS value FROM runs r ORDER BY r.created_at ASC

SELECT r.created_at AS time, CASE r.context WHEN 'bare' THEN 'Baseline (no map)' WHEN 'map' THEN 'Map only' WHEN 'map_rules' THEN 'Map + rules' ELSE r.context END AS metric, r.tool_calls::int AS value FROM runs r ORDER BY r.created_at ASC

SELECT r.created_at AS time, CASE r.context WHEN 'bare' THEN 'Baseline (no map)' WHEN 'map' THEN 'Map only' WHEN 'map_rules' THEN 'Map + rules' ELSE r.context END AS metric, ROUND(r.cost_usd::numeric, 4) AS value FROM runs r ORDER BY r.created_at ASC

panels.title: Change vs previous run
panels.description: Selected-arm deltas between the two most recent runs. Negative tool-call and cost deltas are wins.

targets.rawSql: WITH first_seen AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (run_id) run_id, created_at FROM runs ORDER BY run_id, created_at ASC ), ranked AS ( SELECT run_id, created_at, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rk FROM first_seen ), cur AS (SELECT run_id FROM ranked WHERE rk = 1), prv AS (SELECT run_id FROM ranked WHERE rk = 2), agg AS ( SELECT r.context, MAX(r.tasks_total)::int AS total, MAX(CASE WHEN r.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM cur) THEN r.tasks_passed END)::int AS p_now, MAX(CASE WHEN r.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM prv) THEN r.tasks_passed END)::int AS p_prev, MAX(CASE WHEN r.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM cur) THEN r.tool_calls END)::int AS t_now, MAX(CASE WHEN r.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM prv) THEN r.tool_calls END)::int AS t_prev, MAX(CASE WHEN r.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM cur) THEN r.cost_usd END) AS c_now, MAX(CASE WHEN r.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM prv) THEN r.cost_usd END) AS c_prev FROM runs r GROUP BY r.context ) SELECT CASE agg.context WHEN 'bare' THEN 'Baseline (no map)' WHEN 'map' THEN 'Map only' WHEN 'map_rules' THEN 'Map + rules' ELSE agg.context END AS "Arm", ROUND(100.0 * (p_now - p_prev) / NULLIF(total, 0), 1)::numeric AS "Pass Δ (pp)", (t_now - t_prev)::int AS "Tool calls Δ", ROUND((c_now - c_prev)::numeric, 4) AS "Cost Δ (USD)" FROM agg ORDER BY 1

options.content: The selected run, task by task. Tier 1 asks which symbol a class calls; tier 2 asks which corpus rule applies. Eight tasks is a small sample; read deltas as signal, not proof. Runs marked seeded in the run context row were produced by the rig seeder, not a model.

panels.title: Tasks passed by tier
panels.description: Passes per tier per arm for the selected run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Tier 1 · code facts' AS "Tier", MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'bare' THEN r.passed_tier1::int END) AS "Baseline (no map)", MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'map' THEN r.passed_tier1::int END) AS "Map only", MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'map_rules' THEN r.passed_tier1::int END) AS "Map + rules" FROM runs r WHERE r.run_id::text = '${run}' UNION ALL SELECT 'Tier 2 · cited rules', MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'bare' THEN r.passed_tier2::int END) AS "Baseline (no map)", MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'map' THEN r.passed_tier2::int END) AS "Map only", MAX(CASE WHEN r.context = 'map_rules' THEN r.passed_tier2::int END) AS "Map + rules" FROM runs r WHERE r.run_id::text = '${run}'

panels.title: Per-task matrix
panels.description: Every task against every arm for the selected run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.task_id AS "Task", MAX(CASE WHEN t.context = 'bare' THEN CASE WHEN t.passed THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END END) AS "Baseline (no map)", MAX(CASE WHEN t.context = 'map' THEN CASE WHEN t.passed THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END END) AS "Map only", MAX(CASE WHEN t.context = 'map_rules' THEN CASE WHEN t.passed THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END END) AS "Map + rules" FROM task_results t WHERE t.run_id::text = '${run}' GROUP BY t.task_id ORDER BY t.task_id

panels.title: Grounding distance by tier-2 task
panels.description: Embedding distance between each tier-2 question and its shown chunk. Lower is better; the value is fixed on the task list and identical across arms.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.task_id AS "Task", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN t.context = 'bare' THEN t.grounding_distance END)::numeric, 3) AS "Baseline (no map)", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN t.context = 'map' THEN t.grounding_distance END)::numeric, 3) AS "Map only", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN t.context = 'map_rules' THEN t.grounding_distance END)::numeric, 3) AS "Map + rules" FROM task_results t WHERE t.run_id::text = '${run}' AND t.tier = 2 GROUP BY t.task_id ORDER BY t.task_id

options.content: How the map itself was produced. The sparkline is gate history; only the gate result is pass or fail.

panels.title: Gate result
panels.description: Passed means the latest gate produced a graph.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS result FROM gate_metrics ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Mapping time
panels.description: Seconds the call scan took on the latest gate run. The sparkline is earlier gate runs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, ROUND(wall_time_seconds::numeric, 3) AS value FROM gate_metrics ORDER BY created_at ASC

panels.title: Map nodes
panels.description: Nodes in the extracted graph from the latest gate run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, node_count::int AS value FROM gate_metrics ORDER BY created_at ASC

panels.title: Map edges
panels.description: Edges in the extracted graph from the latest gate run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, edge_count::int AS value FROM gate_metrics ORDER BY created_at ASC

panels.title: Gate history
panels.description: Every stored gate run, newest first.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "At", COALESCE(label, '—') AS "Repo", CASE WHEN passed THEN 'Passed' ELSE 'Not passed' END AS "Result", node_count AS "Nodes", edge_count AS "Edges", ROUND(wall_time_seconds::numeric, 3) AS "Seconds" FROM gate_metrics ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

list.definition: SELECT run_id::text AS value, COALESCE(label, left(run_id::text, 8)) || ' · ' || COALESCE(origin, 'real') || ' · ' || to_char(created_at, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS __text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (run_id) run_id, label, origin, created_at FROM runs ORDER BY run_id, created_at DESC) recent ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
list.label: Run
list.name: run
list.query: SELECT run_id::text AS value, COALESCE(label, left(run_id::text, 8)) || ' · ' || COALESCE(origin, 'real') || ' · ' || to_char(created_at, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS __text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (run_id) run_id, label, origin, created_at FROM runs ORDER BY run_id, created_at DESC) recent ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
